name: Andrzej Nowak
bio:
Andrzej's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After spending years in corporate communications, a chance encounter with a Lechner Racing team member at a charity event sparked his interest. He was captivated by the intensity and passion surrounding racing and saw an opportunity to apply his skills in a thrilling new environment.

At Lechner Racing, Andrzej excels at crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. His calm demeanor and ability to think on his feet make him invaluable during high-pressure situations. Andrzej prides himself on building strong relationships with both the team and the media, ensuring that Lechner Racing's story is always told authentically and effectively. His experience means he can navigate almost any PR problem, and he knows many of the journalists personally, which helps when pitching stories.

physical.description: Andrzej is a man of medium height with a sturdy build and a kind face etched with the lines of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small, leather-bound notebook and pen, preferring handwritten notes.
Has a peculiar habit of polishing his glasses obsessively before important meetings.
